verification_instructions: Static verification only. Confirm: (1) new NestJS routes follow the existing @Controller() + @CurrentUser() u.companyId tenant-scoping pattern; (2) service methods use PrismaService and reuse findOne() ownership checks like the rest of collections.service.ts; (3) no new Prisma fields are introduced (assign/release map onto existing Collection.driverId + status); (4) frontend calls resolve to routes that now exist and dead fallbacks/unreachable code are removed; (5) TypeScript types remain consistent (no new compile errors introduced by edits).

contribution_requirements: Multi-tenancy is mandatory: every backend endpoint must be company-scoped via @CurrentUser() u.companyId (see collections.controller.ts / drivers.controller.ts). Do not remove working code. Do not build speculative subsystems. Additive-only changes.
key_patterns: Backend controllers use class-level @Controller() (some empty, path in each @Get/@Post) and inject a service; services take PrismaService and call this.findOne(id, companyId) as an ownership guard before mutating. Collection model has driverId String? and status CollectionStatus (PENDING/ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS/COLLECTED/FAILED/CANCELLED). DriverStatus = AVAILABLE/ON_ROUTE/... Frontend uses two axios clients: services/api (default import in Collections.tsx) and lib/api + api/client. Collections.tsx currently calls several NON-EXISTENT endpoints.
